title: Stand-сценарии I17 2/3/10 (пишутся, не исполняются) и машинная карта сценариев 1–20
summary: `packages/collaboration/hub/test/stand/{kill-after-retry,two-hubs,sigterm-drain}.stand.js`, `packages/collaboration/hub/stand/docker-compose.yml` (PG + Redis + 2 хаба + `testbench serve`), `scripts/collab-stand.sh`, запись `stand` `collab-stand` в tests/suites.json; `scripts/collab-e2e.sh` и `test/e2e/restore-epoch.e2e.js` переведены на протокол 2; `packages/collaboration/tests/i17-scenarios.json` и `tests/Arch/I17ScenarioMapTest.php` (ключи 1–20, файлы существуют, stand 2/3/10 в test/stand).
why: I17 и контекст фазы: все сценарии collaboration#tests написаны к концу P5; 2, 3, 10 требуют реальных процессов (SIGKILL, два хаба, Redis) и исполняются в PLAN4 (D41). Hard risk: stand-сценарий, проверяющий моки вместо реальных процессов, — ложная уверенность в multi-hub durability.

include: Stand-файлы, compose, скрипт; e2e на протокол 2; карта и тест карты; suites.json stand
exclude: Отложено в PLAN4 (не запускать): `bash scripts/collab-stand.sh`, `bash scripts/collab-e2e.sh`, `docker compose -f packages/collaboration/hub/stand/docker-compose.yml up`, `scripts/t stand`

reads.why: границы P5, точные команды качества, размещение тестов, схема, ledger, прогрессия инвариантов
сценарии I17 этого пункта: линия и файл
Fast-набор D41: что исполняется в пункте

rules: Stand-сценарии работают только с реальными процессами (backend testbench serve на PG, два хаба, Redis); моков backend в них нет.

kill-after-retry: каждое update_id, получившее ack, присутствует в состоянии после SIGKILL всех хабов и перезапуска; two-hubs: состояние содержит обновления обоих хабов; sigterm-drain: после границы drain нет новых receipts, readyz 503 сразу.
I17ScenarioMapTest читает только packages/collaboration/tests/i17-scenarios.json и файловую систему; plans/ не читается.
guidance: Карта — из p5-design#tests-map; пути внутри JSON относительно packages/collaboration. collab-stand.sh: `docker compose up -d --wait`, `node --test test/stand/*.stand.js`, `docker compose down -v` в trap; переменные портов как в collab-e2e.sh. Секции suites.json читать через jq: `jq '.suites.hub, .stand' tests/suites.json`.

validation.cmd: for f in packages/collaboration/hub/test/stand/*.stand.js packages/collaboration/hub/test/e2e/*.e2e.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && bash -n scripts/collab-stand.sh && bash -n scripts/collab-e2e.sh

result.notes:
Stand scenarios I17 2/3/10 written (kill-after-retry, two-hubs, sigterm-drain) against real processes only, with shared live/stand helpers, a docker-compose stand (PG, Redis, testbench serve, hub-a, hub-b) and scripts/collab-stand.sh. collab-e2e.sh and restore-epoch.e2e.js converted to protocol 2 (envelope ack as 'saved', session/restore routes of the documents/collaboration API, compaction/flush intervals). Machine map i17-scenarios.json (keys 1-20) and I17ScenarioMapTest (keys, files exist, lane/file kind, stand 2/3/10 in hub/test/stand, no unmapped stand file). tests/suites.json gets the collab-stand stand entry and the new Arch test in its partition; TestGroupsTest updated for the new stand suite; collaboration baseline refreshed. Nothing from the deferred list was run.
Changed: packages/collaboration/hub/stand/docker-compose.yml, packages/collaboration/hub/stand/testbench.yaml, packages/collaboration/hub/test/e2e/restore-epoch.e2e.js, packages/collaboration/hub/test/stand/kill-after-retry.stand.js, packages/collaboration/hub/test/stand/sigterm-drain.stand.js, packages/collaboration/hub/test/stand/two-hubs.stand.js, packages/collaboration/hub/test/support/live.js, packages/collaboration/hub/test/support/stand.js, packages/collaboration/tests/Arch/I17ScenarioMapTest.php, packages/collaboration/tests/i17-scenarios.json, scripts/collab-e2e.sh, scripts/collab-stand.sh, scripts/t, tests/README.md, tests/Repo/TestGroupsTest.php, tests/baseline/CHANGES.json, tests/baseline/CHANGES.md, tests/baseline/collaboration.count, tests/baseline/collaboration.list, tests/suites.json
deviations: Clients end up read-only on the hub: nothing adds protocol=2 to the hub URL. hub/src/index.js readClientProtocol treats a connection without protocol=2 as protocol 1 (read-only). packages/vue-collaboration/src/transport.ts builds HocuspocusProvider without parameters, and neither the PHP driver nor the session url adds it. The stand/e2e clients add it themselves (test/support/live.js hubUrl).

Changed outside scope.write_set, each needed by the piece: hub/test/support/live.js and hub/test/support/stand.js (helpers shared by e2e and the three stand files), hub/stand/testbench.yaml (host config bind-mounted by the compose backend), tests/Repo/TestGroupsTest.php (its 'scripts/t stand' plan test pinned suites ['load','collab-e2e'] and would be red with collab-stand), tests/README.md and a comment in scripts/t (stand list), tests/baseline/collaboration.{list,count} and CHANGES.{json,md} (refreshed with baseline --write -p collaboration).

V5 (scripts/t baseline --compare, all suites) was not confirmed: vue discovery (npx vitest list) needs registry.npmjs.org, refused by the sandbox (as in P5.4-P5.12). scripts/t baseline --compare -p core,media,drive,webhooks,documents,collaboration,azgard,filament,repo,hub,load exits 0 (collaboration current 380, missing 0).
